name: FoodExpress - Online Food Delivery Platform
description: Enterprise food ordering, dispatch and real-time tracking platform for university Software Engineering coursework.

test_cases.title: Verify dietary preference filter for vegan and gluten-free items
steps: 1. Query menu catalog for Italian cuisine category
2. Apply filter token: 'vegan'
3. Inspect returned dish metadata collection
test_cases.expected: Only dishes containing 'vegan' allergen certificate are returned.

test_cases.title: E2E Menu Search and Dietary Filter Application
steps: 1. Launch mobile food catalog viewport
2. Toggle 'Halal' dietary tag filter
3. Select top restaurant dish and click 'Add to Cart'
test_cases.expected: Halal badge verified on card and item increments cart counter.

test_cases.title: Stripe Tokenization and Card Charge Validation
steps: 1. Construct customer payment intent payload with Stripe test card
2. Call PaymentGatewayAdapter.charge()
3. Verify payment intent status code
test_cases.expected: Returns transaction status 'succeeded' with non-empty charge ID.

test_cases.title: Payment Gateway Latency Benchmark (<3s)
steps: 1. Initiate simulated card authorization of $42.50
2. Record wall-clock execution timer across network roundtrip
3. Verify receipt generation event
test_cases.expected: Complete round-trip transaction completes in less than 3.0 seconds.

test_cases.title: Payment Gateway Card Decline Handling Boundary
steps: 1. Submit expired credit card payload to payment checkout
2. Trigger payment settlement flow
3. Inspect error response and UI messaging
test_cases.expected: System returns graceful CardDeclinedException and prompts user for alternative card without 500 error.

test_cases.title: Courier GPS Coordinate Ingestion Stream
steps: 1. Emit courier telemetry payload (lat: 40.7128, lng: -74.0060, speed: 25 km/h)
2. Subscribe client listener to driver channel topic
3. Validate parsed GeoJSON coordinates
test_cases.expected: GeoJSON coordinate event broadcast to client subscriber within 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Customer Interactive Map UI Live Update
steps: 1. Open live order tracking map view
2. Dispatch 3 sequential courier telemetry pings at 5-second intervals
3. Monitor marker position interpolator
test_cases.expected: Courier map marker updates coordinates smoothly every 5 seconds.

test_cases.title: Mobile Phone Number E.164 Format Validator
steps: 1. Pass valid number '+14155552671' to phone validator
2. Pass invalid number '12345' missing country prefix
3. Assert regex validation outcomes
test_cases.expected: Valid E.164 passes validation; malformed number throws ValidationError.

test_cases.title: SMS One-Time Password Generation and Expiry Flow
steps: 1. Dispatch OTP verification code for mobile registration
2. Submit correct 6-digit pin within validity window
3. Re-submit same token after 300-second expiration
test_cases.expected: Initial submission verifies account; expired submission returns OTP_EXPIRED.

test_cases.title: Enforce Mandatory Phone Verification on Order Submission
steps: 1. Create unverified user session
2. Populate cart with items and attempt checkout execution
3. Verify HTTP response code
test_cases.expected: System rejects order with HTTP 403 Forbidden: Verification Required.

test_cases.title: Menu Catalog API Single Query Latency (<200ms)
steps: 1. Execute GET request to /api/v1/catalog/menu/restaurant-99
2. Measure server response time across 100 consecutive calls
3. Compute 95th percentile latency
test_cases.expected: P95 latency remains strictly below 200 milliseconds.

test_cases.title: Order Ingestion Stress Load at 5000 RPS
steps: 1. Configure load generator to sustain 5000 concurrent RPS for 5 minutes
2. Direct traffic against order creation endpoint
3. Monitor server error logs and response times
test_cases.expected: Average latency remains under 200 ms with error rate less than 0.1%.

test_cases.title: Database AES-256 Storage Encryption Audit
steps: 1. Insert record containing sensitive customer payment details
2. Read raw binary block storage from PostgreSQL tablespace
3. Attempt plaintext ASCII string search for cardholder data
test_cases.expected: No plaintext credentials found; block data is encrypted using AES-256-GCM.

test_cases.title: TLS 1.3 Modern Cipher Handshake Enforcement
steps: 1. Initiate SSL handshake requesting deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols
2. Initiate SSL handshake requesting TLS 1.3 with AES-256-GCM-SHA384
3. Record connection handshake responses
test_cases.expected: Legacy handshake actively aborted; TLS 1.3 handshake negotiates successfully.
